conditions: Holotype of Boulenophrys hengshanensis sp. nov. Measured specimen: holotype HNNU 0706000A, printed as adult female. (Kuang D-Y, Wei Y-F, Luo Y-S, Pei K-W, Cao Y-Y, Zhang M-F, Huang T-F, Pu L, Shi S-C 2025, Animals 15(18): 2745 (MDPI page opened from a search result; ASW cites it as redelimiting B. hengshanensis by naming Boulenophrys gutu)); the sex is therefore disputed and the value is not a reliable female value. One row per specimen, 22 rows (16 males, 6 females). The article preview renders the voucher abbreviations expanded (e.g. 'CSUFT (Institute of Wildlife Conservation, Central South University of Forestry and Technology) HS210602'); the quote gives the code only. The Methods list defines 'LAH' where the table prints 'RAH'. The Table 2 sex column and ED column are read by the page reader. Preserved museum specimen; anatomy only, hearing not tested.
